subject: the 60-second underwrite
preheader: speed isn't a vanity metric — it changes which deals you find.
headline: If a deal takes 30 minutes to underwrite, you'll never find the good ones.
body: Here's the thing nobody tells new investors: the deals that actually pencil are rare. In most markets, maybe 1 in 30 listings cash flows after honest expense assumptions. Maybe 1 in 80 has a DSCR over 1.25.
If your underwriting process takes 30 minutes per property, you're going to look at maybe 10 deals a week. Three a day, tops. That's not a search funnel — that's a wishlist.

Compare that to the investor running 60-second analyses. They can pull 50 addresses from their MLS feed in the morning, kill 47 by lunch, and spend the afternoon deep-diving the 3 that actually work. Same hours. Twenty times the surface area.

That's the whole pitch for TrueCap. Paste an address, get cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, NOI, and a verdict in 60 seconds. The math is the same math your spreadsheet does. It just doesn't require you to type for half an hour.
Pick any random listing right now. Paste it in. See how fast it really is.
